title: FM27 Launch Preview After Free Window — Paid Access to 10 Nov
description: FM27 free Launch Preview ended 3 November 2026 at 18:00 GMT. Paid Preview continues to the 10 November launch via SEGA-approved retailers (10% pre-purchase) or eligible Game Pass; free-period saves carry over.
h1: FM27 Launch Preview after the free window
meta: Updated 4 November 2026 · Free window closed · Paid Preview through 10 November · Checked against Sports Interactive's announcement.
body:
The free FM27 Launch Preview window ended at 18:00 GMT on 3 November 2026 (02:00 on 4 November UTC+8). Football Manager 27 is no longer free to start for everyone. The same Launch Preview continues as a paid period until the full release on 10 November 2026.

What access remains after free play

StageTimeAccess
Free Launch Preview29 October, 18:00 GMT–3 November, 18:00 GMTEnded. No longer open as a free-for-everyone window.
Paid Launch PreviewAfter 3 November, 18:00 GMT, until 10 NovemberPre-purchase through a SEGA-approved digital retailer (10% pre-purchase discount on those channels), or continue via Xbox Game Pass Ultimate / PC Game Pass if eligible.
Full launch10 November 2026Purchased game or applicable subscription. Ending free play did not end Preview access for eligible paid or Game Pass players.

Do not read this as “all Preview access is over.” Only the free-for-everyone window closed; paid Preview and Game Pass paths continue to launch day.

Where to get the paid Launch Preview

PlatformOfficial entry pointAccess check
SteamFootball Manager 27 on SteamUse the current store listing; free-play is no longer the default offer after the window closed.
Epic Games StoreFM27 Launch PreviewUse the Preview listing linked by Sports Interactive / SEGA-approved channels.
Microsoft Store / PC Game PassFM27 Launch PreviewXbox Game Pass Ultimate or PC Game Pass for subscription access, per the announcement.

The official announcement covered free PC/Mac play during the window only. That does not establish a free Console, Mobile or Touch edition, and it does not reinstate free play after 3 November 18:00 GMT.

If you already started during free play

  1. Sports Interactive states that saves started during the free period can continue through the paid Launch Preview and the full release.
  2. Continued access after the free window still needs an eligible purchase (SEGA-approved digital retailer) or an eligible Game Pass subscription.
  3. There is no extra early-access tier beyond Launch Preview; the 10% pre-purchase discount is a purchase incentive on approved channels, not additional free days.

Is FM27 still free / trial / demo / free weekend?

No for new free starts. The five-day free Launch Preview ended at 18:00 GMT on 3 November 2026. Sports Interactive is not labeling this as early access, a permanent free edition, a recurring free weekend, or a classic permanent demo. Remaining pre-launch access is paid Preview (or eligible Game Pass) until 10 November.

Is there FM27 early access?

Sports Interactive is not using an early-access label for FM27. Pre-launch access is the Launch Preview. Its first five days were free for everyone (18:00 GMT 29 October to 18:00 GMT 3 November 2026). After that close, Preview continues as paid access until the 10 November launch for pre-purchasers on SEGA-approved retailers and eligible Xbox Game Pass Ultimate / PC Game Pass subscribers.

Preview data can change

Some Preview information is still awaiting rights-holder approval. Club and player assets may be absent and data may change. Check the game build and source date before relying on a player price, tactic or downloadable pack.
sources: Sports Interactive: Play Football Manager 27 Launch Preview for Free, 21 October 2026; checked 30 October
